t: The Karcher K2 Start Plus Home Pressure Washer is a compact electric pressure washer designed for reliable, occasional outdoor cleaning. With 110 bar pressure and a 1.4kW air-cooled motor, it delivers consistent performance for patios, decking and garden furniture. Supplied with a Vario Power lance, Dirt Blaster nozzle and Home Kit, including a patio cleaner and detergent, it supports efficient surface changes. Smooth wheels, a 4m high-pressure hose and built-in storage allow easy handling on site. Suits light domestic and maintenance tasks.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
